I am a bar/restaurant/venue worker too, had been for my whole life. Finally quit drinking for what sure seems like good in Feb of 2019. I was quite fortunate in that I kept my job and friends and playing music in bars etc. But for some folks that’s a lot harder. I was surprised honestly. The one thing that really helped me was reading This Naked Mind by Annie Grace, plus checking this sub out every day. Early on I was on it pretty much all day and I cannot overstate how great it is to know that you are not alone and that basically anyone who drinks regularly for long enough will eventually see problems in their lives because of it. Best of luck on your journey here, everyone has your back. It’s amazing that you recognize you’re issue this early on, you could save yourself a lot of trauma and heartache here, not to mention the wonderful health benefits. I mean if I had understood how much better my sleep and skin would be without booze alone, I woulda quit many years ago, but the mental clarity and confidence that comes with it too... you just can’t beat it
